name: Spotify Integration
author: plexescor
description: Displays currently playing Spotify track in HPR topbar and logs listening history.
longDescription:
### Features
- Real-time **Spotify playback status** integration.
- Logs listening history directly into HPR analytics timeline.
- Automatic album art and track metadata fetching.

name: Dracula Theme
author: dracula
description: Official dark theme for HPR inspired by the famous Dracula color scheme.
longDescription:
### Theme Highlights
- Vibrant **gothic dark tones** (`#282a36`).
- High-contrast neon accents for text and stats.
- Full support for all HPR dashboard components.

name: Pomodoro Timer & Tracker
author: dev-community
description: Integrated Pomodoro timer synchronized with HPR focus session analytics.
longDescription:
### Workflow Enhancement
- Standard **25m focus / 5m break** intervals.
- Syncs focus periods with HPR activity charts.
- Audio notifications upon interval completion.

name: Catppuccin Mocha Theme
author: catppuccin
description: Soothing pastel theme for HPR featuring Catppuccin Mocha palette.
longDescription:
### Palette Overview
- Soothing **warm pastel colors**.
- Easy on the eyes for late night coding.
- Custom styled borders and card elevation shadows.

name: Git Blame Lens
author: git-tools
description: Provides inline Git blame annotations directly within the active HPR workspace file lines.
longDescription:
### Description
Shows real-time commit metadata inline at the cursor or at the end of lines in HPR. Ideal for debugging and finding authors of complex modules easily.

name: Solarized Dark Theme
author: ethanschoonover
description: Precision dark color theme based on the classic Solarized color palette.
longDescription:
### High-Quality Solarized Theme
- Exact color coordinates from the Solarized palette.
- Extremely balanced contrast for both day and night sessions.

name: Todo Task Manager
author: hpr-fans
description: Clean personal kanban board and todo manager accessible inside your workspace dashboard.
longDescription:
### Task Board
- Kanban columns support.
- Save progress to workspace local config file.
- Integrates with HPR timer sessions.

name: Gruvbox Retro Theme
author: morhetz
description: Retro groove theme for HPR styled with the popular Gruvbox warm pastel colors.
longDescription:
### Warm Retro Looks
- Pastel, low-contrast, eyes-comforting colors.
- Custom styling matching retro terminal designs.

name: Nordic Chill Theme
author: arcticicestudio
description: Clean, dusty, arctic theme for a quiet workspace vibe.
longDescription:
### Arctic Vibe
- Distinct blue-gray ice-cold styling.
- Designed specifically for clean minimalistic interfaces.

name: WakaTime Analytics Tracker
author: wakatime-dev
description: Log editing metrics and track programming language metrics automatically via WakaTime API.
longDescription:
### Setup
- Enter WakaTime API key in preferences.
- Tracks file time metrics, project targets and logs stats.
